crisp/01_orbiting_circle.balance_rationale: Every hull side samples one continuous orbital field; different moments follow world position, not side-specific omission or a copied left/right mask.

region_treatments.intent: All four walls receive the same nested disc, cartographic contour, eclipse-moat, and winner-take-all endpoint rules across world space.
Every silhouette rope samples moving orbital rims and sparse recognition traces; front and back ropes remain part of the same field.
All four Jewelry rails receive the same sparse conjunction-pearl rule, with at most two authored heads rather than a brightness bed.
Every Organ group receives moving body anchors derived from its real world position, including both outboard small-stack rings.
Both 74-pixel signs render complete local planetariums; Sign 2 is counter-chiral and phase-related, never a world-coordinate crop.

crisp/02_dimensional_slicer.balance_rationale: One continuously rotating one-to-three-slab stack crosses both halves; no side receives a permanent color assignment or a two-way partition.

region_treatments.intent: All four walls are crossed by the same sparse parallel slab stack, resolved black kerfs, linear engravings, and exact endpoint bevels.
Every silhouette rope receives narrow moving section lines and slab bevels instead of a uniform outline overlay.
All Jewelry rails carry one smoothly circulating survey head and preserve black heads between measurements.
Every Organ group participates in a crossfaded cohort at the moving slab edge; small and distant groups are not normalized away.
Both signs use complete mirrored local slab sections with matched cadence, reversed moving kerfs, and complementary endpoint order across all 74 addresses.

crisp/03_magnetic_field_collision.balance_rationale: Port and starboard carry opposing magnetic polarity around a shared saddle; energy is matched while color order and circulation are mirrored.

region_treatments.intent: Each wall receives Cassini cages and phase-portrait lanes, mirrored by side around a deliberately black collision saddle.
All silhouette ropes trace opposing field circulation; corresponding port and starboard ropes carry matched energy with reversed polarity.
All Jewelry rails act as sparse field probes, paired by station and mirrored by side while preserving dark heads.
Corresponding Organ groups receive mirrored compression probes, with density-independent impulses on the small-stack rings and auditoriums.
The two complete local signs show matched magnetic phase portraits with mirrored circulation and complementary endpoint ownership.

crisp/06_impossible_corridor.balance_rationale: A single corridor translates and folds through the ship, so corresponding sides meet different rooms at a given instant; every region is visited over time.

region_treatments.intent: All four walls participate in the traveling passage, jamb frames, black alcoves, split route, and room; instantaneous imbalance is narrative, not omission.
Every silhouette rope becomes a moving wall edge or doorway trace as the corridor translates, with front and back ropes visited during the loop.
All Jewelry rails host sparse traveling jamb bolts; head selection follows the corridor split rather than a permanent side bias.
Every Organ group receives threshold lamps when the moving room reaches it, using sparse cohorts so low-density groups remain visible.
Both signs contain complete local floor plans; their opposite chirality describes two coordinated entrances to the same impossible corridor.

crisp/08_topology_knot.balance_rationale: The same two-ribbon knot spans both sides with opposite over-under order, producing matched energy without flattening the topology into symmetry.

region_treatments.intent: All four walls carry broad paired ribbons, nested core and edge contours, and black undercuts; crossing order mirrors between sides.
Every silhouette rope receives ribbon-edge traces and moving underpass cuts, paired by station with opposite depth order.
All Jewelry rails receive at most two separated crossing beads whose order follows the local over-under state.
Every Organ group receives a sparse crossing anchor selected by real position, including low-count outboard stack groups.
Both complete local signs render the same knot with opposite chirality and over-under order across all 74 addresses.

crisp/10_geometric_echo.balance_rationale: Faceted shells are born off-center and translate through a finite archive; side imbalance tracks shell age and travel direction, never a missing region.

region_treatments.intent: Every wall receives shell births, nested facets, black inter-generation gaps, and archived echoes as the finite sequence crosses the model.
All silhouette ropes carry leading corners or selected old facets when an echo reaches their real world position.
All Jewelry rails host one advancing marker plus one dim archived head, translated by generation rather than fixed to one side.
Every Organ group receives sparse birth punctuation as shells pass, with fixture-independent intensity for small and distant groups.
Both signs render complete local nested chevrons; their counter-directed archives remain coordinated and legible across all 74 pixels.
